callsUsed.title: Call with Elevate Communities, LLC. - Terrance Roberson
callsUsed.brief: Athen followed up with Terrance from Elevated Communities, who downloaded Entrata's ebook and is considering switching from Appfolio. Athen gathered information about Terrance's portfolio (600 units across 10 properties) and role, and is coordinating with his sales team to schedule a demo with the appropriate Regional Vice President for the Florida region, aiming for a meeting next week. Athen will send a calendar invite to Terrance shortly.

callsUsed.title: Entrata // Elevate Communities initial call
callsUsed.brief: Athen and Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from JWB Real Estate Capital, discussed JWB's dissatisfaction with Appfolio and their interest in switching to Entrata, focusing on key pain points like inaccurate reporting, lack of auto lease generation, and inefficient maintenance processes. Terrance expressed a desire for Entrata to buy out their Appfolio contract and highlighted reporting, auto lease generation, and maintenance/inspections as top priorities for a potential transition. Entrata will provide a tailored demo addressing these needs and explore potential cost savings through their utility management and AI suites.

callsUsed.title: Elevate Communities + Entrata (Demo # 1)
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Evan from Entrata, along with Kaitlin and Terrance, discussed Entrata's leasing, marketing, reporting, and lead-to-lease workflow capabilities. Key highlights included Entrata's integrated system, robust reporting library with customizable options, AI-powered leasing assistant, and streamlined move-out and maintenance processes. The conversation also touched upon fee transparency, API integrations, and potential for automation in accounting and utility management, with a focus on how Entrata can enhance current workflows and reduce manual tasks.

callsUsed.title: Terrance (Elevate) + Evan (Entrata) Sync
callsUsed.brief: Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed upcoming demo topics focused on accounting processes, resident transfers, move-out inspections, and refunds, as well as Terrance's concerns regarding bulk property offboarding, application fee waivers, and automated lease generation. They also touched upon investor reporting, corporate credit card expense management, and the integration of AI tools. Evan will use Terrance's detailed feedback to prepare Megan for the next demo session, ensuring key areas like payables and management fee calculations are covered.

callsUsed.title: Elevate + Entrata (Demo # 2 - Accounting)
callsUsed.brief: Megan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's comprehensive accounting suite, highlighting its automation capabilities for tasks like specials, concessions, and move-out processes, which significantly reduce manual effort and potential errors compared to their current AppFolio system. The conversation also delved into Entrata's robust reporting and business intelligence tools, emphasizing their customizability and ability to provide deep insights into financial performance, as well as the system's advanced AI integration across various functions. Key pain points with AppFolio, such as data integrity issues and manual processes, were contrasted with Entrata's streamlined workflows and integrated solutions.

callsUsed.title: Elevate Communities + Entrata (Demo # 3)
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's maintenance, inspection, and asset tracking capabilities, highlighting features like AI-powered work order management, customizable inspection templates, and robust job costing for capital projects. Key benefits for Elevate Communities included streamlined vendor management, improved resident communication through automated notifications and translation services, and enhanced data insights for performance tracking and budgeting. The conversation also touched upon the system's flexibility in adapting to Elevate's current operational structure and its potential to significantly improve efficiency and financial oversight.

callsUsed.title: Elevate Communities + Entrata (Demo # 4)
callsUsed.brief: Evan and Megan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's accounting automation capabilities, including vendor management, invoice processing, and AI-driven solutions. They also explored utility management features and the potential for Entrata to streamline Elevate Communities' current manual processes. The conversation highlighted Entrata's intuitive design and comprehensive learning resources, setting the stage for future demos tailored to specific stakeholders.

callsUsed.title: Elevate Communities + Entrata (Demo # 5)
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's resident management features, including AI-powered communication, lease modifications, and automated delinquency notices. Key differentiators highlighted were Entrata's integrated AI platform, live data capabilities, and robust automation for tasks like renewals and collections. The conversation also touched upon resident transfers, ledger management, and the potential for future discussions on utilities and rewards programs.

callsUsed.title: Elevate Communities + Entrata (Demo 6 - Resident Utilities)
callsUsed.brief: Megan, Evan and Gerry from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's utility expense management and resident bill-back services, highlighting how Entrata can act as a utility expert extension for clients and streamline billing processes. They also touched upon Entrata's capabilities in digital marketing, SEO, and insurance, with plans for follow-up meetings to explore these areas further and provide ROI data for Terrance's executive team. The conversation emphasized Entrata's proactive approach to identifying savings and managing utility-related complexities, aiming to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency for Elevate Communities.

callsUsed.title: Elevate + Entrata (Implementation Overview)
callsUsed.brief: Laura and Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed the implementation process, timeline, and team structure for integrating Entrata's platform. Key highlights included Entrata's comprehensive suite of tools, potential cost savings through consolidation, and strategies for managing the transition, particularly concerning AI features and existing contracts. The conversation also touched upon pricing, ancillary revenue opportunities, and the importance of clean data for a successful migration.

callsUsed.title: Elevate + Entrata (Demo #7) DMB + Insurance
callsUsed.brief: Evan, Tanner and Annie from Entrata, along with Terrance from Elevate Communities, LLC., discussed Entrata's comprehensive digital marketing services, including AI-powered SEO, Geo, and paid media strategies, emphasizing data-driven optimization and lead quality. The conversation then shifted to Entrata's Homebody suite, covering renters insurance, a master policy for liability, a deposit alternative program, and credit-building and rewards programs, all designed to integrate seamlessly with Entrata's platform and generate ancillary income. Terrance expressed interest in these offerings, particularly the data-backed marketing approach and the integrated insurance and resident benefit solutions, while also raising questions about current integrations and transition processes.

callsUsed.title: Review: Terrance (Elevate) + Evan (Entrata)
callsUsed.brief: Evan from Entrata, along with Terrance from JWB Real Estate Capital, discussed Entrata's core products, services, and pricing, including significant discounts and waived implementation fees contingent on a September agreement. Terrance expressed Adam's openness to Entrata despite external influences and highlighted the need for open API access for client data. The decision on adopting Entrata is expected by September 9th, following Terrance's presentation to leadership.
